text:
sara (product): quick thread to align on tenant-aware fallback routing for enterprise customers. asks from sales: per-tenant routing policy, ability to pin to Dedicated or fall back to hosted with rate-limited traffic, and clear SLA handoff. want to decide sequencing and owners.

anya (customer-success): customers want deterministic p99 during peak and a documented fallback behavior. they also want an opt-in flag for falling back to hosted instead of failing requests.

tom (eng-runtime): high-level constraints: routing needs to know tenant tier + allowed fallback targets. plan: implement policy layer that checks tenant config, then routes to preferred pool; if pool unavailable, uses fallback chain. major work: 1) policy store + cache, 2) routing adapter, 3) metrics & tracing. estimate ~4 weeks from a small squad.

nina (eng-infra): infra constraints: to guarantee isolated capacity we need reserved node pools per tenant-class or a shared dedicated pool with strict cgroups. Dedicated+fallback requires tagging across LB and runtime. also need quota controller to prevent fallback storms. timeline: reserve pool & label nodes -> 3 days after budget approved.

paul (security): security concerns: cross-tenant routing to hosted path may require data residency checks, encrypt-in-transit enforcement, and cross-control-plane audit entries. fallback-to-hosted must be opt-in for regulated tenants. need a short policy: "no-fallback" tag for regulated tenants.

sara (product): propose minimal launch criteria: 1) policy config UI/CLI to set fallback chain per-tenant, 2) runtime obeys policy and emits fallback events to audit logs, 3) p99 latency for pinned Dedicated path <= 200ms under pilot load, 4) quota controller prevents >5x unexpected traffic to hosted fallback. good?

tom (eng-runtime): agree with criteria. couple of notes: p99 target depends on model size + seq len. for long-form we may need relaxed SLO. we'll add tagging in traces: route.plan=[dedicated|fallback-hosted], route.decision=[served|fellback].

anya (customer-success): can we expose fallback_reason to customers in the billing dashboard? teams want TTL for fallback entries so they can debug.

nina (eng-infra): yes we can push events to tenant telemetry. but storing long history impacts retention costs. propose 30d retention for pilot.

paul (security): add: fallback_event must include audit-id + tenant_id + route_hash. and fallback must be disabled by default for tenants with compliance tags.

sara (product): sequencing suggestion (owners):
- 1) policy model + admin API (owner: sara + tom)
- 2) infra labels & reserved pool + quota controller (owner: nina)
- 3) runtime routing adapter + tracing/audit hooks (owner: tom + paul)
- 4) pilot with 5 tenants, metric guardrails, billing/CS dashboard (owner: anya + sara)
Can we gate 3 behind 2 (i.e., don't enable runtime fallback until reserved pool exists)?

tom (eng-runtime): we can implement safe-defaults that keep fallback disabled until infra signals readiness. that'll work. need 2 small config flags: `routing.enable_fallback` (default false) and `routing.max_fallback_rate_per_tenant` (default 0).

nina (eng-infra): will prepare node pool reservation ticket and a quota-controller CR by EOD Monday. need finance signoff for reserved capacity.

paul (security): I'll draft the compliance matrix for which tenants need fallback-blocked and the minimal audit schema. can review with legal.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: `tenant_fallback_v1` (disabled). will toggle when @sara says go.

anya (customer-success): one more ask: include a rollback plan for when fallback spikes cause billing anomalies. customers want automatic cutover to "fail closed" for affected tenants.

sara (product): good point. add acceptance test: simulated failure causes either (a) blocked fallback and 503s for pinned tenants or (b) controlled fallback with rate-limits. need to choose default.

tom (eng-runtime): recommend default = fail closed for regulated tenants, and controlled fallback for non-regulated. we'll add a per-tenant setting `fallback_behavior: [fail_closed|rate_limited_fallback]`.

nina (eng-infra): operational note: set up an alert on fallback-rate > 1% of total requests and a billing anomaly alert on unexpected egress to hosted pool.

sara (product): next steps: tom break down runtime work into 3 tickets (policy store, adapter, traces) by EOD tomorrow; nina open reservation + quota tickets; paul draft compliance matrix; anya pick 5 pilot tenants and confirm opt-in. i'll assemble launch checklist and propose pilot week. :memo:

ops-bot: scheduled check: `routing.enable_fallback` -> will remain false until manual enable by @sara.

paul (security): one final: ensure hosted fallback path runs under customer-tenant encryption keys where required, otherwise we can't permit fallback. adding to checklist.

sara (product): ok team thanks — will post a short storyboard later today and propose pilot dates. if anyone has objections to sequence or owners, flag here.
